### Create a view for a user-owned project

`POST /users/{user_id}/projectsV2/{project_number}/views` · operationId `projects/create-view-for-user` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/projects/views#create-a-view-for-a-user-owned-project)

- Responses: `201`: application/json `projects-v2-view` · `304` · `401`: application/json `basic-error` · `403`: application/json `basic-error` · `404`: application/json `basic-error` · `422`: application/json `validation-error` · `503`: application/json `basic-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `project_number` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

Request body (`application/json`, required): object

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `layout` | string | yes |  | one of: `table`, `board`, `roadmap` |
| `filter` | string |  |  |  |
| `visible_fields` | array of integer |  |  |  |
| `sort_by` | array of (array of (integer \| string)) |  |  |  |
| `group_by` | array of integer |  |  | max items `1` |
| `vertical_group_by` | array of integer |  |  | max items `1` |
